event_summary: A thin tan stick moves from the right-side black round object and the row of right-side rectangular blocks topples toward the yellow duck while the duck and left-side blocks remain upright.
raw_event_description: At the start, a yellow duck figure stands centered on a wooden tabletop, with upright rectangular blocks arranged in rows on both sides and a black round object behind the right row. A thin tan stick protruding from the black round object changes position and reaches the far-right black rectangular block. The right-side blocks then fall in sequence toward the duck, ending as several right-side blocks lie or lean on the tabletop near the duck's right side. The duck stays upright, and the left-side blocks stay upright.

reasons: The duck, both rows of blocks, the black round object, and the tan stick are visible before the toppling begins.
The relevant objects are not substantially obscured in the first frame.
